whatsNew.subject: What’s new in ToothOps
whatsNew.preheader: Voice charting, imaging reports, consultations, team sharing and ten languages.
whatsNew.title: ToothOps has grown a lot since launch
whatsNew.intro: Since ToothOps launched in November it has become a full chairside workflow for veterinary dentistry. Here are the highlights. Sign in to pick up where you left off.

item1.title: Chart by voice
item1.body: Dictate as you work and AI places each finding on the right tooth, diagram and field, with a final check for anything it wasn’t sure about.

item2.title: Full-mouth charting
item2.body: Triadan grids for cats, dogs and rabbits, linked tooth diagrams, and the full AVDC code set, all kept in sync.

item3.title: Images and imaging reports
item3.body: Pin photos and radiographs to teeth, and write radiographic and CT reports with AI refinement.

item4.title: Consultations, discharge and owner reports
item4.body: Visit-first notes, editable templates, and plain-language take-home reports with before and after photos.

item5.title: Built for the whole practice
item5.body: Shared charts and templates, patient visit history, recheck reminders, and branded PDF charts you can re-import later.

item6.title: Ten languages
item6.body: Use ToothOps in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Hungarian, Romanian, Chinese, Arabic or Polish.
